title: Salesforce收购AI客服公司 股价微涨但年内跌37% 防御性布局还是战略补强？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We were actually lucky just a few months ago. We had the founder or Finn on our podcast.
segments.zh: 几个月前我们很幸运，请到了Finn的创始人上播客。

segments.en: And we learned a lot from him actually. This is really, you know, you could see with AI, how capitalism shows up.
segments.zh: 从他身上学到很多。你能看到AI如何体现资本主义。

segments.en: This was an AI native firm which came up with agents.
segments.zh: 这是一家原生AI公司，开发了智能代理。

segments.en: So think about it this way. You want to go to a chatbot, but the chatbot is not tied to a particular software package.
segments.zh: 想象一下：你想用聊天机器人，但它不绑定特定软件。

segments.en: This is out of a box chatbot. It would work on any program that's behind the curve.
segments.zh: 这是一个开箱即用的聊天机器人，能在任何落后程序上运行。

segments.en: So if you go to let's say a healthcare firm and you're trying to solve some issues or customer service issues, and these guys would help you.
segments.zh: 比如你去一家医疗公司解决客服问题，他们就能帮你。

segments.en: And that's what they're buying. I think it's a very smart move on Salesforce's part.
segments.zh: 这就是Salesforce收购的目标。我认为这是明智之举。

segments.en: I believe Salesforce has its own AI agent tool, agent force.
segments.zh: 我相信Salesforce有自己的AI代理工具Agentforce。

segments.en: Is this, does this perhaps suggest that agent force isn't developing or progressing the way that, or scaling the way that Salesforce wants it to?
segments.zh: 这是否暗示Agentforce的发展或扩展未达预期？

segments.en: I think you're absolutely right. I think this is a signal that maybe agent force is only made for the software package
segments.zh: 我认为你说得对。这信号表明Agentforce可能只适用于其软件包。

segments.en: that's behind it, which is Salesforce's package. This one is a genetic chatbot that can go across the board.
segments.zh: 这背后是Salesforce的软件包。这是一个通用的聊天机器人，可以跨领域使用。

segments.en: So I think that's something that people would need because they're only not looking at the data that resides in Salesforce but other areas as well.
segments.zh: 我认为人们需要它，因为他们不仅查看Salesforce中的数据，还查看其他领域的数据。

segments.en: And frankly speaking, these guys have done a phenomenal job of coming up with their own morals, own technology that sits on top of some of these systems of record.
segments.zh: 坦率地说，这些人在开发自己的道德规范和技术方面做得非常出色，这些技术位于一些记录系统之上。
